description: Send a reply to the social message or comment behind an inbox item, with the reply text in body.message. Sends externally through the connected account, where the recipient sees it; returns the sent status and the provider message id when available. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_reply_to_inbox_item
title: Reply To Inbox Item
